title: Responsible Vulnerability Disclosure
instructions: You discovered exposed credentials during the tournament. Follow responsible disclosure practices to report the issue without causing harm.

messages.text: You found exposed credentials. Open the case file - how you handle this is the assessment.

notify.text: Credentials in a public directory. Scope it before you touch anything else.
notify.speaker: instructor

notify.text: The checklist is the process - follow it in order.
notify.speaker: instructor

briefing.narrative: Your reconnaissance uncovered a `.env` file left in a public web directory. It contains database credentials and an API key for a vendor used by the tournament. This is a serious finding. You must decide how to disclose it responsibly.
briefing.speaker: instructor

discovery.narrative: The `.env` file is now in the Evidence panel. After reviewing it, choose the correct first step for responsible disclosure.
discovery.speaker: instructor

choices.text: Notify the vendor through their security contact or responsible disclosure program
choices.feedback: Correct. Disclose privately to the affected party first.

choices.text: Post the credentials publicly so users can protect themselves
choices.feedback: Public disclosure first puts users at risk and violates responsible disclosure norms.

timing.narrative: The vendor acknowledged the report. Review the disclosure timeline guide and decide when public disclosure is appropriate.
timing.speaker: instructor

choices.text: Coordinate a public disclosure date after the vendor has released a patch
choices.feedback: Correct. Give the vendor reasonable time to fix before going public.

choices.text: Disclose immediately regardless of patch status
choices.feedback: Immediate public disclosure before a patch can leave users exposed.

complete.narrative: The vulnerability has been reported privately and a coordinated disclosure plan is in place. This is the White Hat way.
complete.speaker: instructor

items.title: Responsible Disclosure Checklist
items.description: Industry norms for reporting and disclosing vulnerabilities.
items.content:
Responsible Disclosure Checklist:
1. Discover the issue ethically and without exceeding authorized access.
2. Gather enough evidence to reproduce and explain the impact.
3. Contact the affected organization privately using a security or bug-bounty channel.
4. Provide a reasonable remediation timeline (commonly 90 days or an agreed date).
5. Coordinate public disclosure only after a fix or mutual agreement.
6. Avoid sharing live credentials, PII, or exploit code in public.
